key: ???: \PN, look out!
en: ???: \PN, look out!
ja: ???: \PN、危ない!

key: FERN: Nice miss.
en: FERN: Nice miss.
ja: ファーン: いいミスだね。

key: BLAKE: Thanks, I learned from you.
en: BLAKE: Thanks, I learned from you.
ja: ブレイク: どうも、お前を見て学んだからな。

key: Sirius, consider trying to keep your brat's mouth shut.
en: Sirius, consider trying to keep your brat's mouth shut.
ja: シリウス、そのガキの口を閉じさせておいてくれないか。

key: SIRIUS: Consider focusing on your own task.
en: SIRIUS: Consider focusing on your own task.
ja: シリウス: 自分の仕事に集中することを考えたらどうだ。

key: BLAKE: Hmph.
en: BLAKE: Hmph.
ja: ブレイク: フン。

key: Hey, zipper-lips,
en: Hey, zipper-lips,
ja: おい、口の堅い奴、

key: I know you think you're real cool and all making it this far, but newsflash--
en: I know you think you're real cool and all making it this far, but newsflash--
ja: ここまで来て自分をクールだとでも思ってるんだろうけど、残念なお知らせだ――

key: The only people you've had to face so far have been the team's gutter trash.
en: The only people you've had to face so far have been the team's gutter trash.
ja: お前がこれまで相手にしてきたのは、チームのクズどもだけだ。

key: Zero was already fired, that Terra girl was a joke in the first place, and the Doctor had less of a spine than most Ekans do.
en: Zero was already fired, that Terra girl was a joke in the first place, and the Doctor had less of a spine than most Ekans do.
ja: ゼロはとっくにクビになってたし、テラの奴なんて最初から冗談みたいなもんだったし、ドクターなんてほとんどのアーボより根性がなかった。

key: FERN: Even beating gutter trash is a fluke.
en: FERN: Even beating gutter trash is a fluke.
ja: ファーン: クズを倒すことすらまぐれだろ。

key: \PN couldn't skill himself out of a wet paper bag.
en: \PN couldn't skill himself out of a wet paper bag.
ja: \PNは自分の実力だけじゃ、ぬれた紙袋からも抜け出せないだろうよ。

key: \PN couldn't skill herself out of a wet paper bag.
en: \PN couldn't skill herself out of a wet paper bag.
ja: \PNは自分の実力だけじゃ、ぬれた紙袋からも抜け出せないだろうよ。

key: \PN couldn't skill themself out of a wet paper bag.
en: \PN couldn't skill themself out of a wet paper bag.
ja: \PNは自分の実力だけじゃ、ぬれた紙袋からも抜け出せないだろうよ。

key: And if you gotta problem with me saying so, then come up here and prove otherwise.
en: And if you gotta problem with me saying so, then come up here and prove otherwise.
ja: それが気に食わないなら、ここまで登ってきて違うって証明してみろよ。

key: BLAKE: Oh, wait.
en: BLAKE: Oh, wait.
ja: ブレイク: ああ、待てよ。

key: You can't.
en: You can't.
ja: できないか。

key: There's no way up here.
en: There's no way up here.
ja: ここまでの道がないもんな。

key: Lin set us up on this nest to make sure you didn't get any further.
en: Lin set us up on this nest to make sure you didn't get any further.
ja: リンが俺たちをこの巣に配置したのは、お前をこれ以上先に進ませないためだ。

key: Good luck finding a way up that doesn't exist.
en: Good luck finding a way up that doesn't exist.
ja: 存在しない道を探すのに幸運を祈るよ。

key: And in the meantime...
en: And in the meantime...
ja: そして　それまでの間は……

key: Sandslash, Icicle Crash!
en: Sandslash, Icicle Crash!
ja: サンドパン、つららおとし!

key: SAPHIRA: Not on my watch.
en: SAPHIRA: Not on my watch.
ja: サファイラ: 私が見てる限り、そうはさせない。

key: BLAKE: Oh, look.
en: BLAKE: Oh, look.
ja: ブレイク: おや、見ろよ。

key: An entourage of 'deus ex friendshippia' shows up out of nowhere as always.
en: An entourage of 'deus ex friendshippia' shows up out of nowhere as always.
ja: 『友情マシーナ』のご一行様が、いつも通りどこからともなくお出ましだ。

key: FERN: It's the only way \PN survives.
en: FERN: It's the only way \PN survives.
ja: ファーン: \PNが生き延びる唯一の方法だからね。

key: BLAKE: Hey, wasn't digi-tits supposed to make sure only one of them got through?
en: BLAKE: Hey, wasn't digi-tits supposed to make sure only one of them got through?
ja: ブレイク: おい、デジおっぱいは片方しか通さないようにするはずだったんじゃないのか?

key: SIRIUS: She was, but the result is clear.
en: SIRIUS: She was, but the result is clear.
ja: シリウス: そのはずだったが、結果は見ての通りだ。

key: Find a way to fix it.
en: Find a way to fix it.
ja: 何とかする方法を見つけろ。

key: I'm taking the girl and going ahead.
en: I'm taking the girl and going ahead.
ja: 俺はこの娘を連れて先に行く。

key: AYA: Ow-- stop that, already! Ugh--
en: AYA: Ow-- stop that, already! Ugh--
ja: アヤ: 痛っ――もうやめてよ! うぐ――

key: FERN: There's nowhere even to go.
en: FERN: There's nowhere even to go.
ja: ファーン: 行く場所なんてどこにもないけど。

key: BLAKE: Well, that's their problem, not ours right now.
en: BLAKE: Well, that's their problem, not ours right now.
ja: ブレイク: まあ、それは今の俺たちの問題じゃない。

key: You gonna help out, or what?
en: You gonna help out, or what?
ja: 手伝うのか、どうなんだ?

key: FERN: \PN isn't worth the energy.
en: FERN: \PN isn't worth the energy.
ja: ファーン: \PNなんかに労力使う価値ないし。

key: BLAKE: That's a convenient excuse.
en: BLAKE: That's a convenient excuse.
ja: ブレイク: 都合のいい言い訳だな。

key: FERN: What did you just say?
en: FERN: What did you just say?
ja: ファーン: 今なんて言った?

key: BLAKE: Couldn't hear me over the sound of your own ego?
en: BLAKE: Couldn't hear me over the sound of your own ego?
ja: ブレイク: 自分のプライドがうるさすぎて聞こえなかったか?

key: FERN: Couldn't hear you over the sound of how pathetic \PN is.
en: FERN: Couldn't hear you over the sound of how pathetic \PN is.
ja: ファーン: \PNの惨めさがうるさすぎて聞こえなかったんだけど。

key: It's really deafening.
en: It's really deafening.
ja: ほんと、耳が痛くなるくらいね。

key: You can deal with this on your own; I'm out of here too.
en: You can deal with this on your own; I'm out of here too.
ja: あんたひとりで何とかしなよ。あたしも抜けるから。

key: Later, losers.
en: Later, losers.
ja: じゃあね、負け犬たち。

key: BLAKE: It's a sorry state when I, of all people, am the one pulling the weight.
en: BLAKE: It's a sorry state when I, of all people, am the one pulling the weight.
ja: ブレイク: よりによって俺が一番働いてるとか、情けない話だぜ。

key: Man, I was just in this for the free ride.
en: Man, I was just in this for the free ride.
ja: まったく、俺はただ楽をしたくて入っただけなのに。

key: Now it's this shit show.
en: Now it's this shit show.
ja: それが今じゃこのザマだ。

key: Whatever.
en: Whatever.
ja: まあいいや。

key: \PN, and... whoever you are, other lady,
en: \PN, and... whoever you are, other lady,
ja: \PN、それと…あんたは誰だか知らないけど、

key: Scramble all you want, but this storm isn't stopping.
en: Scramble all you want, but this storm isn't stopping.
ja: 好きなだけ逃げ回ればいい、けどこの嵐は止まらないぞ。

key: SAPHIRA: \PN, you find a way around to deal with it.
en: SAPHIRA: \PN, you find a way around to deal with it.
ja: サファイラ: \PN、あなたは回り道を見つけて対処して。

key: The golden marks on the floor will show you the main path forward, all the way to the northeast exit.
en: The golden marks on the floor will show you the main path forward, all the way to the northeast exit.
ja: 床の金色の印が北東の出口まで、進むべき道を示してくれるはず。

key: I'll draw his attention so you can move more freely,
en: I'll draw his attention so you can move more freely,
ja: 私が彼の注意を引きつけるから、あなたはもっと自由に動けるはず、

key: But be on guard in case he does notice you.
en: But be on guard in case he does notice you.
ja: でも、彼に気づかれた時のために油断しないで。

key: The others won't be far behind; Florinia is working fast.
en: The others won't be far behind; Florinia is working fast.
ja: 他のみんなもすぐ後ろに来てるはず。フロリニアが素早く動いてくれてる。

key: SAPHIRA: Oh, and... thanks for shutting that girl down back there.
en: SAPHIRA: Oh, and... thanks for shutting that girl down back there.
ja: サファイラ: ああ、それと…さっきあの子を黙らせてくれてありがとう。

key: If there's nothing you can do about it, laugh at it.
en: If there's nothing you can do about it, laugh at it.
ja: どうしようもないことなら、笑い飛ばせばいい。

key: Make a joke. Because laughing is better than feeling bad, and it's a great way to say 'fuck you' to all your problems.
en: Make a joke. Because laughing is better than feeling bad, and it's a great way to say 'fuck you' to all your problems.
ja: 冗談を言え。落ち込むより笑ってたほうがマシだし、それに全部の問題に「くたばれ」って言ってやる一番いい方法だからな。

key: When you're on the moon, everything lands the same.
en: When you're on the moon, everything lands the same.
ja: 月の上じゃ、何もかも同じように着地する。

key: That's the dark side for you.
en: That's the dark side for you.
ja: それが月の裏側ってやつさ。

key: An old area map is posted here...
en: An old area map is posted here...
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている…

key: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
en: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
ja: …でも、もう正確ではないようだ。

key: Skip strength puzzle?
en: Skip strength puzzle?
ja: かいりきパズルをスキップする?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
